Text to Speech

Turn any text into spoken audio right in your browser. Pick a voice, adjust speed and pitch, then speak, pause, resume or stop.

Not supported in this browser. Text-to-speech needs a browser with the Web Speech API (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari).

Ready.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste or type the text you want to hear.
  2. Choose a voice from the dropdown.
  3. Adjust the rate and pitch sliders.
  4. Click Speak, and use Pause, Resume or Stop anytime.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the text-to-speech work?

It uses the built-in speech synthesis of your browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari). No audio files are created or uploaded.

Why do I see different voices on different devices?

The voice list comes from your device and browser. Different devices and browsers offer different voices and languages.

The voice list is empty. What should I do?

Some browsers need a moment to load voices. If the list is empty, wait a second and reload the page.
